title: Lower bound for decoding value
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with $q$ labels, let $0<\varepsilon\le 1$, and choose a table of Boolean functions on the Boolean cube, a default label, and a vertex. If at least one coordinate has stable influence greater than $\varepsilon$ in the neighbor-averaged, constraint-permuted function at that vertex, then the decoding value at the vertex is at least $\varepsilon^5/18$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game with $q$ labels
A table of Boolean functions on the Boolean cube
A default label and a vertex
At least one neighbor-averaged notable coordinate, defined by stable influence greater than $\varepsilon$
